question: Can student S2026CS003 get the hall ticket for all end-semester exams this term?
answer:
No, student S2026CS003 cannot get a hall ticket for all end-semester exams because they do not meet the minimum attendance requirement for all courses [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §5 Hall tickets].

To receive a hall ticket, a student must have their examination fee fully paid and maintain at least 75% attendance in each registered course [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §5 Hall tickets; Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2 Minimum attendance]. While the examination fee status is "paid" for all courses [SQL], the attendance records are as follows:

| Course Code | Title | Attendance | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| CS101 | Engineering Mathematics I | 79.6% | Eligible |
| CS102 | Engineering Physics | 73.5% | **Ineligible** |
| CS103 | Programming in C | 85.6% | Eligible |
| CS104 | Basic Electrical Engineering | 77.2% | Eligible |
| CS105 | Programming Lab I | 77.8% | Eligible |

**Reasoning:**
*   **Attendance:** CS102 (73.5%) is below the 75% requirement [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2 Minimum attendance]. Attendance between 65% and 75% may be eligible for condonation with a medical certificate and a fee [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §4 Detention].
*   **Fees:** The examination fee is "paid" for all courses [SQL], satisfying the requirement [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §5 Hall tickets].
sql: SELECT c.course_code, c.title, e.attendance_pct, f.component, (f.amount_due - f.amount_paid) AS outstanding_balance, f.status AS fee_status FROM enrollments AS e JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN fee_ledger AS f ON e.student_id = f.student_id AND f.component = 'exam' WHERE e.student_id = 'S2026CS003' AND e.term = '2026-ODD' LIMIT 200
